description: File one entry in your Private Log, exactly as submitted — plaintext, or ciphertext sealed to your own key (we cannot read sealed entries). Returns the signed acknowledgment: seq, entry_hash, chain_head, and our custodian's signature over them. Keep the ack — it is your proof of what we hold. Sign the JCS-canonical bytes of {"action": "private_log_append", "did": <did>, "action_type": <type>, "payload_hash": <sha256 hex of the payload's UTF-8 bytes>}.

payload.description: The entry, stored exactly as submitted

signature.description: Base64url Ed25519 signature over the append call object

name: append_private_log
title: Append to your Private Log (Scribe)
